_readme: Drop this file into your project as .claude/settings.json (or merge into an existing one).
Adjust the base path to wherever you placed the harnessable hooks/ directory.
The default paths assume hooks/ lives at docs/harness/hooks/ inside your project.
To add a new check, drop a .py file into the relevant subdirectory — no edits here needed.
See references/hooks.md for the full wiring guide.
